RagShortTexts: The Warenne Earls held Lewes and Yorkshire fiefs, stalwartly fielding chequy banners for.

Variants.Content: Descended from the Conquest companion, John de Warenne held the earldom of Surrey and the imposing fortress of Lewes. Linked by blood to Henry III, the family brandished gold-and-azure checkered heraldry to uphold royal authority against rebel barons.
From Sussex coasts to Yorkshire dales, Warenne retainers provided elite knights whenever the crown invoked feudal duties.
